descriptions.notStarted: You discovered that you were a hero that used to wield a Polearm, and just like that, you started to remember a number of your former skills. Your recovered skills are far from optimal, but... You should report this to #b#p1201000##k anyway.
descriptions.inProgress: #p1201000# seems amazed that you was able to recover so many of your abilities and urges you to start training seriously. She then recommends that you go see #b#p1202006# the Penguin Master#k, an old penguin that's studied the intricacies of various hero skills. He's located in the west side of town at #m140010100#.
